notes.title: Less Than a Month Until Dinosaurs in Place Releases!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278647/cfff91a10cd578df289654bb2483f6d3215ffb17.png[/img]
🦖 [b]Less Than a Month to Go![/b]

Friends, time flies! On March 4, 2025, Dinosaurs in Place will launch on Steam! We’re excited for this moment and hope you’ll enjoy diving into prehistoric puzzles.

🧩 [b]What is Dinosaurs in Place?[/b]
It’s a relaxing puzzle game where you need to place quirky dinosaurs correctly on a grid using their unique shapes. The difficulty increases with each level, but the gameplay remains intuitive and engaging.

[b]What to Expect?[/b]
✔ 100 levels with increasing challenge
✔ 40 uniquely shaped dinosaurs
✔ Immersive visuals
✔ Perfect for logic game fans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278647/624ccd89781de2d6f2c34858a3a4f12fed7ab57c.png[/img]

🎮 [b]Great Steam Deck Support![/b]
We’ve tested Dinosaurs in Place on Steam Deck, and it runs flawlessly! With smooth gameplay, comfortable controls, and the ability to play anywhere, it's a perfect fit for portable gaming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278647/1e8a09993772f4345d5f8211017b75539d8216d4.png[/img]

🙏 [b]Thank You for Your Support![/b]
A huge thank you to everyone who has added the game to their wishlist and is looking forward to the release! Your support motivates us to make the game even better. Just a little longer—see you soon in the world of dinosaurs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278647/5cca42afe2353feb92354f17d4f528e41276673e.png[/img]
